freshSetup.note: Throwaway fresh checkout with no .env, .dev.vars, .foilbury, .wrangler, sibling checkout mutation or provider binding. Setup installed schema, accounts, curated imports, renders and release.

limitations: No live provider verification: FAL, Resend, ElevenLabs and Discord were not contacted.
